question: What is the revenue growth rate month-over-month?

  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL OR LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 1.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)
  END AS revenue_growth_rate
FROM monthly_rev
ORDER BY month ASC
